body: Added readyplayer1/rl/rssm_v2_broader_progression.py and CLI command r1 subsim rl-rssm-v2-broader. Added versioned presets for broader progression and tier2/tier3 stages plus tier-specific gate presets. Outputs now include dreamer_rssm_v2_broader_progression_summary.json|md and dreamer_rssm_v2_tier_expansion_recommendation.json|md with second-order pathology and drift-monitoring aggregation.
summary: ReadyPlayer1 now includes a dedicated broader RSSM-v2 workflow that runs tier1 control, tier2 expansion, and gated tier3 probe while carrying replay/live drift monitoring artifacts through each stage.
title: RSSM v2 broader staged progression now uses tier-gated expansion with per-stage drift monitoring

body: These bounded runtime changes reduce replay/live step-order and episode-boundary mismatch without changing controller family or broad scenario scope. The drift-investigation pass keeps the same bounded confirmation bed and validates parity/test surfaces with deterministic tests plus one end-to-end canonical run.
summary: Live sonar harness now advances first post-reset step to tick 1 and RL env now forces done_reason=max_steps on truncation when no reason exists.
title: Replay/live parity cleanup applies tick-order and truncation done-reason normalization

body: The canonical replay/live workflow now writes alignment diffs, per-scenario alignment trace previews, and drift summaries with category counts and prior-run comparison. Continuation output consumes the drift summary recommendation directly when live confirmation executes, using outcome states drift_reduced_continue_progression, drift_reduced_but_monitor, still_blocked_by_replay_live_drift, or runtime_contract_mismatch_needs_deeper_fix.
summary: ReadyPlayer1 RSSM v2 canonical expansion now emits alignment-diff and drift-summary artifacts and binds continuation decisions to blunt drift outcomes in live-executed runs.
title: RSSM v2 continuation now gates on replay/live drift summary outcomes

body: Implemented recurrent architecture selection in `run_dreamer_experiment_lane` (`architecture_core`, `architecture_history_window`, `policy_kind=architecture`) and added `readyplayer1/rl/recurrent_upgrade.py` plus `dreamer_recurrent_architecture_upgrade_preset_v1.json`. The lane emits `dreamer_recurrent_architecture_upgrade_summary.json|md` with architecture-specific diagnostics and recommendation fields. Canonical run: `runs/20260419T222435Z-subsim_rl_recurrent_upgrade-871bae` recommends continuing Dreamer training with upgraded core `dreamer_rssm_v2`.
summary: ReadyPlayer1 now supports a bounded recurrent model-core ablation lane (`rl-upgrade-recurrent`) that compares `dreamer_core_v1` and `dreamer_rssm_v2` on the same canonical progression bed. The first canonical run selected `dreamer_rssm_v2` with decision `recurrent_upgrade_reduces_blockage`.
title: Recurrent architecture upgrade lane added for Dreamer continuity ablation

body: Implemented `readyplayer1/rl/state_space_refinement.py` and `readyplayer1/eval/scenarios/subsim/dreamer_state_space_refinement_preset_v1.json` to run deterministic state-only ablations on the existing progression ladder. Progression pathology logic now includes continuity-specific failure labels (`contact_hypothesis_instability`, `reacquisition_link_failure`, `belief_decay_miscalibration`, `transition_signal_weakness`, `state_surface_shortcutting`) plus `continuity_gain_realized` as a positive signal. The first canonical run (`runs/20260419T220932Z-subsim_rl_state_space-f48d24`) concluded `state_surface_refinement_still_blocked` with recommended next branch `deeper_recurrent_state_space_architecture_change`.
summary: ReadyPlayer1 now includes a continuity-first `state_v3_state_space` observation variant and a dedicated `rl-refine-state-space` workflow that compares state_v1/state_v2/state_v3 with reward fixed. Canonical artifacts are emitted as `dreamer_state_space_refinement_summary.json|md` under `runs/`.
title: State-space continuity refinement v3 added as canonical RL ablation lane

body: Added CLI flags for --control-mode baseline|experimental, --experimental-controller, fallback baseline selection, and guardrail thresholds. Suite summaries now include experimental_control aggregates and per-scenario gate classifications with optional baseline-reference comparison.
summary: `r1 subsim suite` and run/replay paths now expose explicit control-mode flags and experimental-controller guardrail settings while preserving baseline-only defaults.
title: Subsim suite now supports baseline, shadow, and experimental control modes

body: Implemented ExperimentalControlAgent with hard validation, timeout handling, abstain handling, heading-delta bounds, thrash detection, and one-way rollback to baseline. Deterministic runs now emit control_events.jsonl and experimental_control_summary.json; reports include experimental control gate outcomes.
summary: ReadyPlayer1 now supports an explicit experimental control mode where a learned controller can act under strict guardrails with automatic fallback to belief_baseline.
title: Subsim experimental control lane uses one-way baseline rescue

body: Run `r1 subsim suite --agent belief_baseline --compare-golden tests/fixtures/subsim_scenario_suite_golden_thresholds.json --out runs/` for comparative regression checks. The pytest regression set is `tests/test_subsim_scenario_pack.py`, `tests/test_subsim_failure_taxonomy.py`, and `tests/test_subsim_suite_runner.py` plus existing sonar integration tests.
summary: Suite-level regression is now gated by deterministic scenario summaries compared against golden metric bounds. Tests validate scenario pack structure, taxonomy behavior, and summary stability.
title: Canonical Subsim suite regression gate in ReadyPlayer1

body: Added readyplayer1/eval/failure_taxonomy.py and wired classification into deterministic run outcomes. Report rendering now includes scenario context, taxonomy labels/evidence, and key-event timeline snippets. This gives faster triage of perception vs policy vs scenario-quality issues while preserving heuristic transparency.
summary: Deterministic sonar runs now include heuristic failure-taxonomy labels in `outcome.failure_taxonomy`, and reports render those labels with evidence. Taxonomy is metric-backed guidance, not deterministic causal proof.
title: Failure taxonomy is now a first-class report surface for sonar runs

body: Added scenario pack contracts and replay fixtures under readyplayer1/eval/scenarios/subsim/, plus suite execution logic in readyplayer1/eval/subsim_suite.py. CLI now supports `r1 subsim suite` with optional scenario filtering and golden-threshold comparison. This shifts evaluation from a single replay path to repeatable multi-archetype comparative analysis.
summary: ReadyPlayer1 now has a seven-scenario deterministic Subsim sonar suite with scenario intent metadata and expected metric bounds. Comparative suite runs emit per-scenario and aggregate summaries for design and balancing decisions.
title: ReadyPlayer1 now evaluates Subsim sonar via a deterministic scenario pack and comparative suite runner

body: Use `r1 subsim replay --agent belief_baseline --sonar-replay tests/fixtures/subsim_sonar_replay_fixture.jsonl --out runs/` for deterministic sonar-policy iteration. Validate with pytest targets `tests/test_subsim_sonar_adapter.py`, `tests/test_subsim_sonar_replay_harness.py`, and `tests/test_subsim_belief_baseline_golden.py`. Sonar runs now emit `policy_observation_trace.jsonl`, optional `truth_trace.jsonl`, and optional `truth_alignment_trace.jsonl` in each run directory.
summary: ReadyPlayer1 now has deterministic sonar replay fixtures and a golden belief-baseline regression test. Runs emit separate policy observation and truth alignment artifacts for offline analysis.
title: Subsim sonar replay regression path in ReadyPlayer1

body: Implemented readyplayer1/harness/subsim/sonar_adapter.py as the consumer-facing boundary, then wired SubsimHarness to support obs_source=legacy|sonar_console|sonar_console_replay. Replay mode ingests sonar JSONL deterministically; live mode consumes SonarConsole per tick. This isolates Subsim internals and keeps ReadyPlayer1-side observation shape stable for future policy/model work.
summary: ReadyPlayer1 now normalizes Subsim sonar-console perceived frames via a dedicated adapter and runs the Subsim harness in explicit legacy/live/replay observation modes. The policy input contract is perception-only and does not include truth fields.
title: ReadyPlayer1 now consumes Subsim sonar console through a dedicated adapter boundary
